description_en: Invokes the ListIntervalAgentReport operation to retrieve the interval statistical report for a specified agent in a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListIntervalAgentReport获取指定实例下指定坐席的分段统计报表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-interval-agent-report --agent-id agent@ccc-test --instance-id ccc-test --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIntervalAgentReport

parameters.help_en: The start time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is optional. Default value: 00:00:00 of the current day. The statistical time precision is in hours. The time is rounded down, and the interval is closed
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认为当天的0时，统计的时间精度为小时，向前取整，闭区间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is optional. Default value: the current time. If Interval is set to Daily, the maximum interval between StartTime and EndTime is 180 days. If Interval is set to Hourly, the maximum interval is 10 days. The statistical time precision is in hours. The time is rounded up, and the interval is open. For example, if the start time is 11:12:20 and the end time is 11:45:50, the aligned time range is [11:00:00, 12:00:00), which means greater than or equal to 11:00 and less than 12:00
parameters.help_zh: 截止时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认是当前时间，如果Interval为Daily，StartTime和EndTime最大间隔是180天。如果Interval为Hourly，最大间隔时间为10天。统计的时间精度为小时，向后取整，开区间。例如：开始时间为11:12:20，结束时间为11:45:50，则对齐后的入参时间范围为[11:00:00,12:00:00)，即大于等于11点，小于12点
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The interval statistics type. This parameter is optional. Default value: Daily
parameters.help_zh: 分段统计类型，非必填，默认为Daily（按天汇总）
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The media type. Default value: Audio. Other valid values include Chat and Video
parameters.help_zh: 媒体类型，默认是语音(Audio), 其他可选参数包括Chat和Video
parameters.name: media_type
